# Step 2: the whole 2,720.00 USD spent out of the bank at a later rate, drawn
# against the cost basis the invoice opened.
#
# `{usd_basis}` is the basis split `fx-balances` reports after step 1
# (`tests/fixtures/a_usd_invoice_collected_into_a_usd_bank.txt`). A guid is
# made fresh on every import, so it cannot be written into a fixture: the test
# reads it from that listing and substitutes it before importing this ledger
# onto that book.
#
# What it leaves: a bank holding nothing, a consumed basis, and the difference
# between what the US dollars cost and what they fetched booked as realized FX
# — which is the state a real book was in when its balance sheet still claimed
# an unrealized gain of 19.86 CAD on an account holding zero.

# The dollars leave valued at what they cost — 189557/136000 CAD per USD, so
# 3,791.14 CAD for the 2,720.00 — while the bank receives the 3,771.28 the sale
# actually fetched. The 19.86 between them is the realized loss, and it stands
# apart in the residual rather than being folded into either side; the importer
# refuses a disposal valued at the sale rate for exactly that reason.
2026-08-17 * "Sent the whole balance out"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 3771.28 CAD
	Assets:Bank:USD -2720.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "189557/136000"
		value: "-3791.14"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{usd_basis}"
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
